comment: Sizes (GiB) for the cache entries scripts/ci/check-cache-budget.mjs derives from the workflows. Each entry is looked up as `projected`, then `measured`, then `estimates`: keys are workflow:job (rust-cache), the derived key name (go-cache, npm-cache) or `actions/cache <key family>` (a workflow's own actions/cache save, which has no estimate: an unsized one fails). `measured` is `gh api actions/caches` on `measuredOn`, main's entries only; `projected` holds the entries a change resized that no nightly has measured yet, with the reason in `projectedWhy`; when the nightly janitor (ci-image-cleanup.yml) prints the new sizes, move them to `measured`. `fixed` are entries no step of these kinds writes. The janitor warns when main's entries drift from this plan by more than 1 GiB and FAILS when they hold more than the 8 GiB budget. 2026-11-23 reconciliation: main held 8.33 GiB in 92 entries against a plan of 7.71 (rust worker-rust-test 1.78 planned 1.27; desktop-host 1.73 planned 1.6; the gateway's Go key 0.56 planned 1.2; npm 0.94 planned 0.6, of which a macOS copy of the web lockfile's entry 0.19 and mobile 0.41; BuildKit blobs 0.79 planned 0.6).

projectedWhy.ci-rust.yml:test: 1.78 measured (one feature set, full debug info). Now both image sets with CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0, cargo's git database trimmed to the pinned commits (0.23 GiB of tree-sitter history out) and the build scripts' object files dropped. The desktop host's dependencies measured 2.29 GiB with line tables and 1.17 without (2026-11-20); the same halving of the ~1.25 GiB of dependencies, plus ~0.3 of registry, is ~0.95.
projectedWhy.ci-desktop.yml:desktop: 1.73 measured; the trimmed git database takes the 0.23 GiB of tree-sitter history out, and the build scripts' object files go.
projectedWhy.actions/cache cargo-git-db-v1-: ci-rust-shared.yml's git database, trimmed: tree-sitter-cpp measured 96 MB before and 1.8 MB after the trim (local, 2026-11-23); tree-sitter-c-sharp 144 MB before.

fixed.family: buildkit-blob layers and buildx indexes (66 + 8 entries)
the rest (buildx binary, golangci-lint, CodeQL status, scripts/ci npm)
